statement: For the finite setting [def-pur-conventions], retain the eleven original definitions of lem-pur-finite-kummer-level: the positive-level coefficient quotient, its constant sheaf, the iterated scalar-extension Tate line [def-pur-twist-sheaves], the finite-root tensor, their local pure tensors and the normalized projection, derived and base-change predicates. Only their module location changes; their full names, types and bodies are retained.
